attributes.name: promo section background treatment
attributes.definition: How promotional sections/blocks are visually backed: tinted band, dark/grey flat band, photo background, or other.

values.definition: Full-width band with a soft tinted/pastel colour background
Full-width band in solid dark or grey with no imagery behind
Promo uses a photograph or image ad as its backdrop
No promo sections or a different treatment

attributes.name: promo section width
attributes.definition: Whether promotional blocks span the full viewport width or are contained.

values.definition: Promo spans the entire viewport width
Promo sits within the content column as a card

attributes.name: promo content composition
attributes.definition: How content within a promo block is arranged.

values.definition: Text stack (kicker, title, copy, button) paired with a photo in a split layout
Plain text content without accompanying imagery
Promo dominated by an image or banner ad
